title: RunState
description: Canonical run state for training.dataset_build. Includes ownership/version fields for stale-save detection.

run_id.description: UUID or content-hash identifier for this run.

writer_id.description: Owner/agent identifier. Used to detect cross-agent state conflicts.

state_version.description: Monotonically increasing version. Incremented on every state write. Clients include base_state_version in save payloads for stale-save detection.

writer_epoch.description: Optional epoch or timestamp for cross-agent coordination. Allows agents to detect if another writer has taken ownership.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this run was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this state was last modified.

status.description: Current phase of the dataset build pipeline.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the config used for this run. Allows detection of config changes between resumes.

schema_version_source.description: Package-local parser provenance for configs that omitted schema_version.

buckets.description: Per-bucket state. Keyed by bucket name.

item_ids.description: Item IDs assigned to this bucket.

processed_source_ids.description: Source IDs that have been fully processed (acquired + extracted). Used for resume to avoid re-downloading.

acquisition_results.description: Per-round source acquisition metadata for quality reporting.

review_decisions.description: Review decisions keyed by item_id. Only items with an explicit accept/reject decision appear here.

filter_stats.description: Aggregated filter statistics across all stages.

caption_validation_failures.description: Caption validation failures collected before manifest export.

quality_report.description: Path to quality_report.json when generated for this run.

top_up_rounds.description: Number of top-up rounds executed so far.

submitted.description: Whether the final review /submit has been received.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run was completed or finalized.
